newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican bullfighter near death after fall.
newsitem.headline: Mexican bullfighter near death after fall.

text.p: A mounted bullfighter was battling for his life on Monday after a bull threw his horse on top of him in Mexico City's main bullring, crushing him in front of thousands of spectators.

Televisa television network, which has exclusive broadcasting rights at the Plaza de Toros Mexico, said it was the worst accident in the bullring's history, and that "rejoneador" Eduardo Funtanet, 33, was in a coma on the verge of death.
He was crushed on Sunday when the bull charged his horse, knocking its hind legs out from underneath it. The horse rolled over on Funtanet and the saddle fractured his skull, Televisa said.
As he lay on the bullring floor, the bull charged the horse. Funtanet's colleagues dragged him to safety, blood pouring from his mouth and nose from burst internal organs.

Rejoneadors use unprotected horses to stick lances into bulls before killing them in what is seen by aficionados as a major test of horsemanship and courage. Mexico City has the world's largest bullring that seats around 45,000.
